title: Debate Outlines
text:
A debate outline is a plan that helps a speaker organize their arguments before a debate begins. It usually starts with a clear statement of the main claim. After that, the speaker lists the reasons that support the claim, and each reason is followed by evidence such as facts or examples. A good outline also predicts the arguments of the other side.

Many students find outlines useful because they keep their thoughts in order. When a speaker forgets a point, the outline shows what comes next. Some debaters also write short notes for rebuttals, which are responses to the opponent's arguments. Teachers often ask students to prepare an outline before they speak, so that the debate is fair and easy to follow.

questions.text: According to the passage, what usually comes first in a debate outline?
options: A list of the judges' names
A clear statement of the main claim
A summary of the other side's history
A final conclusion for the audience

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what do some debaters write short notes for?
options: The time limit of the debate

questions.text: Why would a speaker with a good outline probably feel more confident?
options: Because the outline removes the need to listen to the opponent
Because the outline makes the debate shorter
Because the outline replaces all evidence
Because the outline keeps their points in order and shows what comes next

questions.text: What can be inferred about teachers who ask students to prepare outlines?
options: They want students to avoid speaking in class
They want debates to be fair and easy to follow
They think debates should have no rules
They believe evidence is not important

vocabulary.definition: a plan that shows the main points in order
a statement that someone says is true and tries to prove
facts or examples that support an idea
replies that show an argument is wrong

paragraph_translations: План для дебатів — це структура, яка допомагає промовцеві організувати аргументи ще до початку дебатів. Зазвичай він починається з чіткого формулювання головної тези. Після цього промовець перелічує причини, що підтримують тезу, і після кожної причини наводяться докази, наприклад факти чи приклади. Хороший план також передбачає аргументи другої сторони.

Багатьом студентам плани корисні, бо вони впорядковують думки. Коли промовець забуває пункт, план показує, що буде далі. Деякі дебатери також записують короткі нотатки для спростувань, тобто відповідей на аргументи опонента. Викладачі часто просять студентів підготувати план перед виступом, щоб дебати були чесними і їх було легко слідкувати.
